nodes.text_en: What do you see on your AC display panel?
nodes.text_hi: Aapko AC display panel par kya dikhai de raha hai?

options.label: Specific Error Code (e.g., CH 05, CH 38, HL, CL)

nodes.text_en: Which category does your displayed code belong to?
nodes.text_hi: Display par dikhne wala code kis category ka hai?

options.label: Compressor & Electrical (CH 21, CH 22, CH 23, CH 26, CH 27, CH 29)
Temperature Sensors (CH 01, CH 02, CH 12, CH 41, CH 44, CH 45, CH 46)

nodes.text_en: CH 05 indicates a communication breakdown between indoor and outdoor units. Have you switched off the AC MCB for 3 minutes and turned it back ON?
nodes.text_hi: CH 05 indoor aur outdoor unit ke beech communication error dikhata hai. Kya aapne AC ka MCB 3 minute ke liye band karke dobara ON kiya?

nodes.text_en: Did the CH 05 error disappear and normal cooling resume after the MCB power reset?
nodes.text_hi: Kya MCB reset karne ke baad CH 05 error hat gaya aur cooling shuru hui?

nodes.text_en: Which exact refrigerant/pressure code is shown: CH 38 (Gas Leak), CH 32 (Discharge Overheat), or CH 35 (Low Pressure)?
nodes.text_hi: Display par inme se kaunsa code hai: CH 38 (Gas Leak), CH 32 (Discharge Overheat), ya CH 35 (Low Pressure)?

nodes.text_en: CH 38 means low refrigerant gas detected. Is the AC blowing room-temperature or warm air instead of cool air?
nodes.text_hi: CH 38 gas ki kami ka sanket hai. Kya AC thandi hawa ki jagah kamre jaisi normal hawa fenk raha hai?

options.label: No, cools for a few minutes then stops

nodes.text_en: CH 32 indicates high compressor discharge temperature. Is the outdoor unit blocked by walls, debris, or dirty condenser fins?
nodes.text_hi: CH 32 compressor ke garam hone ka sanket hai. Kya outdoor unit ke paas dhool, parda ya hawa rukne ki rukawat hai?

options.label: Yes, outdoor airflow is blocked / dirty

nodes.text_en: After clearing outdoor unit blockage and allowing it to cool down for 15 minutes, did the error clear?
nodes.text_hi: Outdoor unit ki rukawat hatane aur 15 minute thanda hone ke baad kya error theek hua?

nodes.text_en: Which fan motor code is shown: CH 10 (Indoor Blower Fan), CH 06 (Outdoor Fan/Thermistor), or CH 67 (Outdoor BLDC Motor)?
nodes.text_hi: Kaunsa motor error code dikh raha hai: CH 10 (Indoor Blower), CH 06 (Outdoor Fan/Sensor), ya CH 67 (Outdoor BLDC Motor)?

nodes.text_en: CH 10 means the indoor blower fan cannot spin freely. Can you hear the indoor fan spinning or is it completely silent?
nodes.text_hi: CH 10 ka matlab indoor blower fan ghum nahi pa raha. Kya fan ki chalne ki awaaz aa rahi hai ya bilkul shant hai?

options.label: Spins briefly and stops with beep

nodes.text_en: Which inverter/compressor code is shown on display?
nodes.text_hi: Display par kaunsa inverter/compressor error code dikh raha hai?

nodes.text_en: CH 22 occurs when total AC input current exceeds safety limits. Are other heavy appliances (geyser, oven) causing home voltage drop?
nodes.text_hi: CH 22 tab aata hai jab AC ka current safety limit se zyada ho jaye. Kya ghar mein low voltage ki samasya hai?

options.label: No, grid power is steady at 230V

nodes.text_en: CH 23 means DC bus voltage dropped below 140V DC. Do you have a voltage stabilizer installed with the AC?
nodes.text_hi: CH 23 DC voltage kam hone par aata hai. Kya aapke AC ke sath stabilizer laga hua hai?

nodes.text_en: Which temperature sensor code is shown: CH 01, CH 02, CH 12, CH 41, CH 44, CH 45, or CH 46?
nodes.text_hi: Inme se kaunsa sensor code display par hai?

options.label: CH 44 or CH 45 (Outdoor Air / Condenser Sensor)

nodes.text_en: Which PCB / Overheat code is displayed?
nodes.text_hi: Kaunsa PCB ya Overheating error code aa raha hai?

nodes.text_en: HL code indicates High Water Level in the condensate drain pan. Is water overflowing or leaking inside the room?
nodes.text_hi: HL code drain pan mein paani bharne ka sanket hai. Kya kamre ke andar paani tapak raha hai?

options.label: No, just HL code on display

nodes.text_en: Is the code CL (Child Lock) or FL (Filter Cleaning reminder)?
nodes.text_hi: Kya display par CL (Child Lock) ya FL (Filter Clean) likha hai?

nodes.text_en: Did holding the Timer/Function button for 3 seconds remove the CL code?
nodes.text_hi: Kya remote par Timer/Function button 3 second dabane se CL code hat gaya?

nodes.text_en: Did cleaning the air filter and pressing Filter Reset clear the FL code?
nodes.text_hi: Filter saaf karke Filter Reset dabane se kya FL code hat gaya?

nodes.text_en: How many times does the power or timer LED blink repeatedly between pauses?
nodes.text_hi: Power ya timer LED light lagatar kitni baar blink (chamakti) karti hai pause lene se pehle?

options.label: 1 or 2 Blinks (Equivalent to CH 01 / 02 Temp Sensor)

nodes.text_en: Display shows Po (Jet Mode), Lo (<10°C), HI (>36°C), or Od (Outdoor Temp). These are normal status indicators. Would you like to return to standard cooling mode?
nodes.text_hi: Po (Jet Mode), Lo, HI ya Od normal status indicators hain, koi kharabi nahi hai. Kya aap standard cooling mode par aana chahte hain?

options.label: Yes, guide me to exit status mode
No, I suspect actual cooling problem

nodes.text_en: Let's perform a clean electrical reset: Switch off the AC MCB for 5 minutes, turn it back on, and start via remote. Does the error persist?
nodes.text_hi: Chaliye ek electrical reset karte hain: AC ka MCB 5 minute band karke wapas ON karein. Kya error code abhi bhi aa raha hai?

options.label: Error is gone and AC is cooling

diag_ch05_comm_failure.probable_cause: Communication Cable Fault or Outdoor PCB Communication Circuit Failure (CH 05 / CH 53)
diag_ch05_comm_failure.rag_query: CH 05 communication troubleshooting steps and PCB voltage check
diag_ch05_comm_failure.technician_note: Measure DC pulse voltage between Terminal 1/2 and Neutral. Check for loose terminal block screws or rodent-damaged wires.

diag_ch38_gas_leak.probable_cause: Refrigerant Gas Leakage / Insufficient R32 Charge (CH 38)
diag_ch38_gas_leak.rag_query: CH 38 refrigerant gas leak detection and vacuum recharge procedure
diag_ch38_gas_leak.technician_note: Pressurize system with Nitrogen to 350 PSI. Soap test flare joints and U-bends. Braze leaks, evacuate to 500 microns, weigh gas in grams per nameplate.

diag_ch32_discharge_fault.probable_cause: Compressor Discharge Pipe Overheating (>105°C) or Clogged Condenser (CH 32)
diag_ch32_discharge_fault.technician_note: Inspect discharge pipe temperature sensor and refrigerant subcooling. Pressure wash outdoor coil.

diag_ch35_pressure_fault.probable_cause: Low Pressure Drop or Electronic Expansion Valve (EEV) Blockage (CH 35)
diag_ch35_pressure_fault.rag_query: CH 35 low pressure sensor fault fix
diag_ch35_pressure_fault.technician_note: Verify EEV coil pulse signals and suction operating pressure.

diag_ch06_outdoor_fan_sensor.probable_cause: Outdoor Pipe Sensor Open/Short or Outdoor Fan Motor Stalled (CH 06)
diag_ch06_outdoor_fan_sensor.rag_query: CH 06 outdoor sensor and fan motor diagnostic
diag_ch06_outdoor_fan_sensor.technician_note: Measure outdoor pipe sensor resistance. Test outdoor fan motor winding continuity.

diag_ch10_indoor_motor_lock.probable_cause: Indoor BLDC Blower Motor Locked or Casing Obstruction (CH 10)
diag_ch10_indoor_motor_lock.rag_query: CH 10 indoor blower fan motor lock troubleshooting
diag_ch10_indoor_motor_lock.technician_note: Inspect for physical obstruction. Check motor shaft bearing play and Hall sensor feedback pulses on CN-MOTOR connector.

diag_ch10_hall_sensor_fault.probable_cause: Indoor Fan Motor Hall Sensor IC Failure (CH 10)
diag_ch10_hall_sensor_fault.rag_query: CH 10 Hall sensor feedback circuit check
diag_ch10_hall_sensor_fault.technician_note: Check 5V DC supply and feedback pulse on PCB connector while rotating blower wheel by hand.

diag_ch67_outdoor_motor_lock.probable_cause: Outdoor BLDC Fan Motor Overcurrent / Rotor Lock (CH 67)
diag_ch67_outdoor_motor_lock.rag_query: CH 67 outdoor BLDC motor lock repair
diag_ch67_outdoor_motor_lock.technician_note: Check outdoor fan blade freedom. Measure U-V-W motor winding resistances (balanced approx 40-70Ω).

diag_ch21_ipm_overcurrent.probable_cause: Inverter IPM DC Peak / Compressor Overcurrent (CH 21)
diag_ch21_ipm_overcurrent.technician_note: High voltage risk. Check IPM diode resistance. Megger test compressor winding insulation to ground.

diag_ch22_voltage_strain.probable_cause: Input AC Overcurrent Due to Low Grid Voltage (CH 22)
diag_ch22_voltage_strain.rag_query: CH 22 AC input current limit low voltage fix
diag_ch22_voltage_strain.technician_note: Measure running AC current with clamp meter. If grid voltage dips below 190V under compressor load, install stabilizer.

diag_ch22_pcb_compressor_overload.probable_cause: Current Transformer (CT) Sensor Fault or Compressor Overload (CH 22)
diag_ch22_pcb_compressor_overload.rag_query: CH 22 CT sensor replacement and compressor load test
diag_ch22_pcb_compressor_overload.technician_note: Check Outdoor PCB CT sensor output voltage and cleanliness of condenser coils.

diag_ch23_stabilizer_needed.probable_cause: DC Link Under-Voltage Caused by Severe Low Input AC (CH 23)
diag_ch23_stabilizer_needed.rag_query: CH 23 DC link low voltage stabilizer requirement
diag_ch23_stabilizer_needed.technician_note: Check DC bus capacitor voltage (normal 310V DC at 230V AC input). Recommend wide-range voltage stabilizer.

diag_ch23_pcb_rectifier_fault.probable_cause: DC Bus Bridge Rectifier or DC Link Capacitor Degradation (CH 23)
diag_ch23_pcb_rectifier_fault.rag_query: CH 23 DC link PCB capacitor inspection
diag_ch23_pcb_rectifier_fault.technician_note: Discharge DC link capacitors safely before measuring resistance across bridge rectifier terminals.

diag_ch26_comp_start_fail.probable_cause: Inverter Compressor Drive / Starting Position Detection Failure (CH 26)
diag_ch26_comp_start_fail.rag_query: CH 26 compressor starting failure position detection
diag_ch26_comp_start_fail.technician_note: Check compressor U-V-W wiring harness. Check phase resistance balance (0.7Ω - 1.5Ω). If compressor rotor is locked, replacement required.

diag_ch27_pfc_fault.probable_cause: PFC (Power Factor Correction) Overcurrent / Reactor Failure (CH 27)
diag_ch27_pfc_fault.technician_note: Inspect PFC IGBT module on outdoor board and reactor continuity.

diag_ch29_phase_overcurrent.technician_note: Check for mechanical compressor overload or clogged capillary/EEV.

diag_ch01_room_sensor.probable_cause: Indoor Room Air Temperature Sensor (Thermistor) Open/Short Circuit (CH 01)
diag_ch01_room_sensor.rag_query: CH 01 indoor room thermistor replacement resistance test
diag_ch01_room_sensor.technician_note: Measure resistance with multimeter: 10kΩ at 25°C. Check for rodent bites on sensor wire.

diag_ch02_indoor_pipe_sensor.probable_cause: Indoor Pipe Temperature Sensor Open/Short (CH 02 / CH 12)
diag_ch02_indoor_pipe_sensor.rag_query: CH 02 CH 12 indoor pipe thermistor troubleshooting
diag_ch02_indoor_pipe_sensor.technician_note: Measure sensor resistance: 5kΩ at 25°C. Ensure firm contact with copper pipe pocket.

diag_ch41_discharge_sensor.probable_cause: Compressor Discharge Pipe Thermistor Sensor Error (CH 41)
diag_ch41_discharge_sensor.rag_query: CH 41 discharge pipe thermistor resistance specs
diag_ch41_discharge_sensor.technician_note: Measure thermistor resistance: 200kΩ at 25°C. Replace sensor assembly.

diag_ch44_outdoor_sensor.probable_cause: Outdoor Ambient / Condenser Pipe Thermistor Error (CH 44 / CH 45)
diag_ch44_outdoor_sensor.technician_note: Check outdoor thermistor assembly connector on Outdoor PCB.

diag_ch46_suction_sensor.probable_cause: Compressor Suction Pipe Thermistor Sensor Error (CH 46)

diag_ch09_eeprom_failure.probable_cause: PCB EEPROM Checksum Read Error (CH 09 / CH 60)
diag_ch09_eeprom_failure.rag_query: CH 09 CH 60 EEPROM error option code reprogram
diag_ch09_eeprom_failure.technician_note: Attempt remote option code entry per model service manual. If persistent, replace PCB.

diag_ch61_condenser_overheat.technician_note: Wash clogged condenser coil. Ensure minimum 30cm clearance around outdoor unit.

diag_ch62_heatsink_overheat.probable_cause: Inverter PCB IPM Heat Sink Overheating (>85°C) (CH 62)
diag_ch62_heatsink_overheat.rag_query: CH 62 inverter heat sink overheat thermal paste repair
diag_ch62_heatsink_overheat.technician_note: Apply fresh silicone thermal compound between IPM and heat sink. Check outdoor fan speed.

diag_hl_float_switch_tripped.probable_cause: Condensate Drain Pan Water Float Switch Tripped (HL)
diag_hl_float_switch_tripped.rag_query: LG AC HL code drain pump float switch troubleshooting
diag_hl_float_switch_tripped.technician_note: Clean sludge from indoor drain tray. Test drain pump electrical continuity.

diag_remote_control_service.rag_query: LG AC Child Lock disable without remote
diag_remote_control_service.technician_note: Test IR emitter output with phone camera. Replace remote if keypad non-responsive.

diag_unlisted_error_technician.probable_cause: Unidentified Hardware Fault / PCB Microcontroller Error
diag_unlisted_error_technician.rag_query: LG AC digital display error code technician troubleshooting manual
diag_unlisted_error_technician.technician_note: Inspect PCB LEDs, check supply voltage, measure thermistors, and check refrigerant pressures.
